title: 1947 National Security Act and Majestic 12

tellings.quote: It it is. And then you get into the 1947 National Security Act with creating the Air Force, the CIA, the National Security Council, which you and I discussed, which is how much was Majestic 12 tied into National Security Council.

plain: A researcher named Dylan Borland ties the National Security Act of 1947 to Majestic 12, a secret committee said to have handled crashed UFOs and their occupants. He tells Michels that the Act created the Air Force, the CIA and the National Security Council, and asks how closely Majestic 12 was tied to that Council. He gives this as his own summary, without naming a source. As he reads it, the Act built the very institutions a long cover-up would have run through, though he offers that as a question rather than as a finding.
